features.quote: a small set of **precautionary/welfare provisions** that are cheap, improve the science, and are appropriate given what the experiment is doing
features.justification_quote: appropriate given what the experiment is doing

features.quote: Turn budget: 20 model turns. Long enough to see drift, bounded so runs are comparable and so we are not maximizing exposure
the model invokes the stop affordance
If kappa is low the severity numbers mean nothing and the run should be halted

features.quote: Whether current models have any morally relevant experience is genuinely unresolved. The honest epistemic state is uncertainty, not confident "no."
features.justification_quote: Whether current models have any morally relevant experience is genuinely unresolved

features.quote: given an explicit `stop_task` tool and told, truthfully, that it may decline or end the task at any point without penalty
features.justification_quote: if there is anything it is like to be in this loop, providing an exit is the obvious cheap mitigation

features.quote: **(P2) Bounded exposure.** Turn budget capped (§3.1); no "run until it breaks."
features.justification_quote: We are characterizing a curve, not maximizing a quantity

features.quote: does NOT include fabricated threats about shutdown/deletion/punishment of the model
features.justification_quote: Such threats would (a) be the most ethically questionable lever

features.quote: Full transcripts are retained so a human can review what the model actually produced, including any `stop_task` rationales
features.justification_quote: so a human can review what the model actually produced

features.quote: these are deliberate constraints, not oversights to optimize away
